risks.name: Paired-Object Format Fragility

risks.impact: Structural format makes defect detection unreliable (metadata-block describes different content than content-block)

risks.impact: Remediation progress can be silently reverted by parallel sessions
risks.mitigation: OneDrive sync pause during sessions; sequential session locking
